```{python}
regex = r"^(.*)\.([AB])$"

def clean_ticker(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        pl.when(
            (pl.col(col).str.len_chars() == 5)
            & (pl.col(col).str.slice(4, 1) == "E")
        )
        .then(pl.col(col).str.slice(0, 4))
        .when(pl.col(col).str.contains(regex))
        .then(pl.col(col).str.replace(regex, "${1}"))
        .otherwise(pl.col(col))
    )

def get_shrcls(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.col(col).str.extract(regex, group_index=2)

sho_r3000_tickers = (
    sho_r3000
    .select("russell_ticker", "russell_name")
    .with_columns(
        ticker=clean_ticker("russell_ticker"),
        shrcls=get_shrcls("russell_ticker"),
    )
)

crsp_sample = (
    stocknames
    .with_columns(test_date=pl.date(2004, 6, 25))
    .filter(
        (pl.col("test_date") >= pl.col("namedt"))
        & (pl.col("test_date") <= pl.col("nameenddt"))
    )
    .select("permno", "permco", "ticker", "shrcls")
    .unique()
    .collect()
)

sho_r3000_merged = (
    sho_r3000_tickers
    .join(crsp_sample, on="ticker", how="inner", suffix="_crsp")
    .filter(
        pl.col("shrcls").is_null()
        | (pl.col("shrcls") == pl.col("shrcls_crsp"))
    )
    .select("russell_ticker", "permco", "permno")
)

trading_vol = (
    msf
    .filter(pl.col("date") == pl.date(2004, 6, 30))
    .with_columns(
        dollar_vol=(pl.col("prc").abs() * pl.col("vol")).fill_null(0)
    )
    .select("permno", "dollar_vol")
    .collect()
)

sho_r3000_merged = (
    sho_r3000_tickers
    .join(crsp_sample, on="ticker", how="inner", suffix="_crsp")
    .filter(
        pl.col("shrcls").is_null()
        | (pl.col("shrcls") == pl.col("shrcls_crsp"))
    )
    .join(trading_vol, on="permno", how="inner")
    .sort(["russell_ticker", "dollar_vol"], descending=[False, True])
    .unique(subset=["russell_ticker"], keep="first")
    .select("russell_ticker", "permno")
)

nmsind_data = (
    mse
    .filter(
        pl.col("date") <= pl.date(2004, 6, 28),
        pl.col("event") == "NASDIN"
    )
    .filter(pl.col("date") == pl.col("date").max().over("permno"))
    .select("permno", "date", "nmsind")
    .collect()
)

exchcd_data = (
    stocknames
    .filter(pl.col("exchcd") > 0)
    .with_columns(pl.date(2004, 6, 28).alias("test_date"))
    .filter(
        pl.col("test_date").is_between(
            "namedt", "nameenddt", closed="both"
        )
    )
    .select("permno", "exchcd")
    .unique()
    .collect()
)

ipo_dates = (
    dseexchdates
    .select("permno", "begexchdate")
    .unique()
    .collect()
)

recent_delistings = (
    mse
    .filter(
        pl.col("event") == "DELIST",
        pl.col("date").is_between(pl.date(2004, 6, 25),
                                  pl.date(2004, 6, 28)),
    )
    .rename({"date": "delist_date"})
    .select("permno", "delist_date")
    .collect()
)

sho_r3000_permno = (
    sho_r3000_merged
    .join(nmsind_data, on="permno", how="left")
    .join(exchcd_data, on="permno", how="left")
    .join(ipo_dates, on="permno", how="left")
    .join(recent_delistings, on="permno", how="left")
    .with_columns(
        nasdaq_small=
            (pl.col("nmsind") == 3).and_(pl.col("exchcd") == 3)
            .fill_null(False),
        recent_listing=pl.col("begexchdate") > pl.date(2004, 4, 30),
        delisted=pl.col("delist_date").is_not_null()
    )
    .with_columns(
        keep=pl.all_horizontal(
            ~pl.col("nasdaq_small"),
            ~pl.col("recent_listing"),
            ~pl.col("delisted"),
        )
    )
)

sho_r3000_sample = (
    sho_r3000_permno
    .filter(pl.col("keep"))
    .rename({"russell_ticker": "ticker"})
    .join(sho_tickers, on="ticker", how="left")
    .with_columns(pilot=pl.col("co_name").is_not_null())
    .select("ticker", "permno", "pilot")

ccm_link = (

        pl.col("linkprim").is_in(["C", "P"]),

    .rename({"lpermno": "permno"})
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("linkenddt")

    )
    .select("gvkey", "permno", "linkdt", "linkenddt")

gvkeys = (
    ccm_link
    .with_columns(test_date=pl.date(2004, 6, 28))
    .filter(pl.col("test_date").is_between("linkdt", "linkenddt"))
    .select("gvkey", "permno")
    .collect()
)

sho_r3000_gvkeys = (

    .filter(pl.len().over("gvkey") == 1)
    .join(fhk_pilot, on=["gvkey", "pilot"], how="inner")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_outcomes(rho: float = 0.0, periods: int = 7) -> pl.DataFrame:
    e = np.random.normal(size=periods)
    y = np.empty(periods, dtype=float)
    y[0] = e[0]
    for i in range(1, periods):
        y[i] = rho * y[i - 1] + e[i]
    return pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "t": np.arange(1, periods + 1),
            "y": y,
        }
    )

def get_sample(n: int = 100, rho: float = 0.0,
               periods: int = 7, effect: float = 0.0) -> pl.DataFrame:
    treat = set(np.random.choice(np.arange(1, n + 1),
                size=n // 2, replace=False).tolist())
    t_effects = pl.DataFrame({
        "t": np.arange(1, periods + 1),
        "t_effect": np.random.normal(size=periods),
    })
    df = pl.concat(
        [
            get_outcomes(rho=rho, periods=periods)
            .with_columns(pl.lit(i).alias("id"))
            for i in range(1, n + 1)
        ],
        how="vertical",
    )
    return (
        df
        .join(t_effects, on="t", how="inner")
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("id").is_in(list(treat)).alias("treat"),
            (pl.col("t") > (periods / 2)).alias("post"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            (
                pl.col("y")
                + pl.when(pl.col("treat") & pl.col("post"))
                .then(effect)
                .otherwise(0.0)
                + pl.col("t_effect")
            ).alias("y")
        )
        .select(pl.exclude("t_effect"))
    )

def _ols_coef(y: pl.Series, X: pl.DataFrame, coef_idx: int) -> float:
    y_np = y.to_numpy()
    X_np = X.to_numpy()
    X_np = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y_np)), X_np])
    beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X_np, y_np, rcond=None)[0]
    return float(beta[coef_idx])

def est_effect(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    did_df = df.with_columns(
        (
            (pl.col("treat") & pl.col("post"))
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .alias("treat_post")
        ),
        pl.col("treat").cast(pl.Float64).alias("treat_f"),
        pl.col("post").cast(pl.Float64).alias("post_f"),
    )
    est_did = _ols_coef(
        did_df["y"],
        did_df.select("treat_f", "post_f", "treat_post"),
        coef_idx=3,
    )
    df_post = (
        df.filter(pl.col("post"))
        .group_by("id", "treat")
        .agg(pl.col("y").mean().alias("y"))
        .with_columns(pl.col("treat").cast(pl.Float64).alias("treat_f"))
    )
    est_post = _ols_coef(df_post["y"], df_post.select("treat_f"), coef_idx=1)
    df_change = (
        df.group_by("id", "treat", "post")
        .agg(pl.col("y").mean().alias("y"))
        .pivot(values="y", index=["id", "treat"], on="post")
        .rename({"false": "y_pre", "true": "y_post"})
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("y_post") - pl.col("y_pre")).alias("y_change"),
            pl.col("treat").cast(pl.Float64).alias("treat_f"),
        )
    )
    est_change = _ols_coef(df_change["y_change"], df_change.select("treat_f"), coef_idx=1)
    est_ancova = _ols_coef(df_change["y_post"], df_change.select("y_pre", "treat_f"), coef_idx=2)
    return pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "est_DiD": [est_did],
            "est_POST": [est_post],
            "est_CHANGE": [est_change],
            "est_ANCOVA": [est_ancova],
        }
    )

def run_sim(i: int, n: int = 100, rho: float = 0.0,
            periods: int = 7, effect: float = 0.0) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df = get_sample(n=n, rho=rho, periods=periods, effect=effect)
    return est_effect(df).with_columns(pl.lit(i).alias("i")).select(
        "i", "est_DiD", "est_POST", "est_CHANGE", "est_ANCOVA"
    )

rhos = np.linspace(0.0, 0.9, 6)
effects = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 5)

def run_sim_n(effect: float, rho: float, **kwargs) -> pl.DataFrame:
    n_sims = 1000
    np.random.seed(2021)
    res = pl.concat(
        [run_sim(x, rho=rho, effect=effect, **kwargs)
         for x in range(n_sims)],
        how="vertical",
    )
    return (
        res.with_columns(
            pl.lit(effect).alias("effect"),
            pl.lit(rho).alias("rho"),
        )
        .select("effect", "rho", "i",
                "est_DiD", "est_POST", "est_CHANGE", "est_ANCOVA")
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# Long-running: iterates over all combinations of effect and rho values,
# running 1000 simulations each — takes several minutes.
from itertools import product

with ptime():
    results = pl.concat(
        [run_sim_n(effect=effect, rho=rho)
         for effect, rho in product(effects, rhos)],
        how="vertical")
```

```{python}
tidy_results = (
    results
    .unpivot(
        index=["rho", "effect"],
        on=pl.selectors.starts_with("est"),
        variable_name="method",
        value_name="est",
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("method").str.replace(r"^est[_\.](.*)$", r"$1")
    )
    .filter(pl.col("method") != "CHANGE")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
dsf = load_parquet("dsf", "crsp")

spreads = (
    dsf
    .with_columns(
        spread=100 * (pl.col("ask") - pl.col("bid")) /
                     ((pl.col("ask") + pl.col("bid")) / 2),
        quarter=pl.col("date").dt.truncate("1q"),
    )
    .group_by("permno", "quarter")
    .agg(pl.col("spread").mean().alias("spread"))
    .with_columns(post=pl.col("quarter") >= pl.date(2004, 1, 1))
    .filter(
        pl.col("spread").is_not_null(),
        pl.col("quarter").is_between(pl.date(2000, 1, 1),
                                     pl.date(2008, 1, 1))
    )
    .collect()
)

rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)

treatment = (
    spreads
    .filter(~pl.col("post"))
    .group_by("permno")
    .agg(pl.col("spread").mean().alias("spread"))
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("spread") > pl.col("spread").median())
        .then(0.55)
        .otherwise(0.45)
        .alias("treat_prob")
    )
    .pipe(lambda df: df.with_columns(rand=rng.random(df.height)))
    .with_columns(treat=pl.col("rand") < pl.col("treat_prob"))
    .select("permno", "treat")
)

reg_data = spreads.join(treatment, on="permno", how="inner")

fm_placebo = pf.feols(
    "spread ~ post * treat",
    vcov={"CRV1": "permno"},
    data=reg_data.to_pandas(),
)
```

```{python}
funda = load_parquet("funda", "comp")

compustat_annual = (
    funda
    .filter(
        pl.col("indfmt") == "INDL",
        pl.col("datafmt") == "STD",
        pl.col("popsrc") == "D",
        pl.col("consol") == "C",
        pl.col("fyear").is_between(1999, 2012),
        ~pl.col("sich").is_between(6000, 6999),
        ~pl.col("sich").is_between(4900, 4949),
    )
    .select(
        "gvkey", "fyear", "datadate", "fyr", "sich", "dltt",
        "dlc", "seq", "oibdp", "ib", "ibc", "oancf", "xidoc",
        "at", "ppegt", "sale", "rect", "ceq", "csho", "prcc_f",
    )
    .with_columns(fyear=pl.col("fyear").cast(pl.Int32))
    .collect()
)

controls_raw = (
    compustat_annual
    .sort(["gvkey", "fyear"])
    .with_columns(lag_fyear=pl.col("fyear").shift(1).over("gvkey"))
    .with_columns(
        mtob=
            pl.when(pl.col("ceq").shift(1).over("gvkey") != 0)
            .then(
                pl.col("csho").shift(1).over("gvkey")
                * pl.col("prcc_f").shift(1).over("gvkey")
                / pl.col("ceq").shift(1).over("gvkey")
            ),
        leverage=
            pl.when((pl.col("dltt") + pl.col("dlc") + pl.col("seq")) != 0)
            .then((pl.col("dltt") + pl.col("dlc")) /
                  (pl.col("dltt") + pl.col("dlc") + pl.col("seq"))),
        roa=
            pl.when(pl.col("at").shift(1).over("gvkey") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("oibdp") / pl.col("at").shift(1).over("gvkey")),
    )
    .filter(pl.col("fyear") == (pl.col("lag_fyear") + 1))
    .select("gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "at", "mtob", "leverage", "roa")
)

controls_filled = (
    controls_raw
    .sort(["gvkey", "fyear"])
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("mtob", "leverage", "roa")
        .forward_fill()
        .over("gvkey")
    )
)

controls_fyear_avg = (
    controls_filled
    .group_by("fyear")
    .agg(
        pl.col("mtob", "leverage", "roa").mean().name.suffix("_avg")
    )
)

df_controls = (
    controls_filled
    .join(controls_fyear_avg, on="fyear", how="left")
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("mtob").fill_null(pl.col("mtob_avg")),
        pl.col("leverage").fill_null(pl.col("leverage_avg")),
        pl.col("roa").fill_null(pl.col("roa_avg")),
    )
    .select("gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "at", "mtob", "leverage", "roa")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
WIN_VARS = ["at", "mtob", "leverage", "roa", "da_adj", "acc_at"]

def fit_mod_jones(g: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    y = g["acc_at"].to_numpy()
    X = np.c_[np.ones(g.height),
              g.select(["one_at", "sale_c_at", "ppe_at"]).to_numpy()]
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    coef_names = ["b_intercept", "b_one_at", "b_sale_c_at", "b_ppe_at"]
    return pl.DataFrame(dict(zip(coef_names, beta)))

def get_das(compustat: pl.DataFrame,
            drop_extreme: bool = True) -> pl.DataFrame:
    for_disc_accruals = (
        compustat
        .join_where(
            get_ff_ind(48),
            (pl.col("sich") >= pl.col("sic_min")) &
            (pl.col("sich") <= pl.col("sic_max")),
        )
        .sort(["gvkey", "fyr", "fyear"])
        .with_columns(lag_at=pl.col("at").shift(1).over(["gvkey", "fyr"]))
        .filter(pl.col("lag_at") > 0)
        .with_columns(
            lag_fyear=pl.col("fyear").shift(1).over(["gvkey", "fyr"]),
            lag_sale=pl.col("sale").shift(1).over(["gvkey", "fyr"]),
            lag_rect=pl.col("rect").shift(1).over(["gvkey", "fyr"]),
        )
        .with_columns(
            acc_at=(pl.col("ibc") - (pl.col("oancf") - pl.col("xidoc"))) /
                        pl.col("lag_at"),
            one_at=1 / pl.col("lag_at"),
            ppe_at=pl.col("ppegt") / pl.col("lag_at"),
            sale_c_at=(
                pl.col("sale") - pl.col("lag_sale")
            ) / pl.col("lag_at"),
            salerect_c_at=((pl.col("sale") - pl.col("lag_sale")) -
                           (pl.col("rect") - pl.col("lag_rect"))) /
                            pl.col("lag_at"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            _keep=pl.when(pl.lit(drop_extreme))
            .then(pl.col("acc_at").abs() <= 1)
            .otherwise(True)
        )
        .filter(
            pl.col("_keep"),
            pl.col("fyear") == (pl.col("lag_fyear") + 1),
            pl.col("salerect_c_at").is_not_null(),
            pl.col("acc_at").is_not_null(),
            pl.col("ppe_at").is_not_null()
        )
        .drop("_keep")
        .with_columns(num_obs=pl.len().over(["ff_ind", "fyear"]))
        .filter(pl.col("num_obs") >= 10)
    )
    fm_da = (
        for_disc_accruals
        .era.map_by(["ff_ind", "fyear"], fit_mod_jones)
    )
    return (
        for_disc_accruals
        .join(fm_da, on=["ff_ind", "fyear"], how="left")
        .with_columns(
            nda=pl.col("b_intercept")
            + pl.col("one_at") * pl.col("b_one_at")
            + pl.col("ppe_at") * pl.col("b_ppe_at")
            + pl.col("salerect_c_at") * pl.col("b_sale_c_at")
        )
        .with_columns(da=pl.col("acc_at") - pl.col("nda"))
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "ff_ind", "acc_at", "da")
    )

def get_pm(
    compustat: pl.DataFrame,
    pm_lag: bool = True,
    drop_extreme: bool = True,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    das = get_das(compustat, drop_extreme=drop_extreme)
    if pm_lag:
        ib_at_expr = pl.col("lag_ib").era.div_if_pos("lag_at")
    else:
        ib_at_expr = pl.col("ib").era.div_if_pos("at")
    perf = (
        compustat
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("at", "ib")
            .shift(1)
            .over("gvkey", order_by="fyear")
            .name.prefix("lag_")
        )
        .with_columns(ib_at=ib_at_expr)
        .join(das.select("gvkey", "fyear", "ff_ind"),
              on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="inner")
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "ff_ind", "ib_at")
    )
    perf_match = (
        perf
        .join(perf, on=["fyear", "ff_ind"], how="inner", suffix="_other")
        .filter(pl.col("gvkey") != pl.col("gvkey_other"))
        .with_columns(
            perf_diff=(pl.col("ib_at") - pl.col("ib_at_other")).abs()
        )
        .with_columns(
            min_perf_diff=pl.col("perf_diff")
            .min()
            .over(["gvkey", "fyear"])
        )
        .filter(pl.col("perf_diff") == pl.col("min_perf_diff"))
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "gvkey_other")
    )
    perf_matched_accruals = (
        das
        .rename({"gvkey": "gvkey_other", "da": "da_other"})
        .select("fyear", "gvkey_other", "da_other")
        .join(perf_match, on=["fyear", "gvkey_other"], how="inner")
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "gvkey_other", "da_other")
    )
    return (
        das
        .join(perf_matched_accruals, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="inner")
        .with_columns(da_adj=pl.col("da") - pl.col("da_other"))
        .select(
            "gvkey", "fyear", "acc_at", "da",
            "da_adj", "da_other", "gvkey_other"
        )
    )

def get_pmdas(
    compustat: pl.DataFrame,
    pm_lag: bool = True,
    drop_extreme: bool = True,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        get_pm(compustat, pm_lag=pm_lag, drop_extreme=drop_extreme)
        .sort(["gvkey", "fyear"])
        .unique(subset=["gvkey", "fyear"], keep="first")
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
```
```{python}
ctrls_list = ["np.log(at)", "mtob", "roa", "leverage"]

def reg_year_fe(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    dv: str = "da_adj",
    controls: bool = True,
    firm_fe: bool = False,
    cl_2: bool = True,
    post_all: bool = False,
):
    data = (
        df
        .with_columns(year=pl.col("datadate").dt.year())
        .with_columns(
            during=pl.col("year").is_in([2005, 2006, 2007]),
            post=pl.col("year") >= 2008 if post_all else
                 pl.col("year").is_in([2008, 2009, 2010]),
        )
    )
    rhs = "pilot * (during + post)"
    if controls:
        rhs = rhs + " + " + " + ".join(ctrls_list)
    fe = " | gvkey + year" if firm_fe else " | year"
    formula = f"{dv} ~ {rhs}{fe}"
    vcov = {"CRV1": "gvkey"} if not cl_2 else {"CRV1": "gvkey + year"}
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.filterwarnings(
            "ignore", category=UserWarning, module="pyfixest"
        )
        return pf.feols(formula, data=data, vcov=vcov,
                        demeaner_backend="scipy")

def make_reg_table(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    dv: str = "da_adj",
    cl_2: bool = True,
    post_all: bool = False,
):
    specs = [
        {"controls": False, "firm_fe": False},
        {"controls": True,  "firm_fe": False},
        {"controls": False, "firm_fe": True},
        {"controls": True,  "firm_fe": True},
    ]
    fms = [
        reg_year_fe(
            df,
            dv=dv,
            controls=s["controls"],
            firm_fe=s["firm_fe"],
            cl_2=cl_2,
            post_all=post_all,
        )
        for s in specs
    ]
    show_typst(ETable(
        fms,
        signif_code=[0.01, 0.05, 0.1],
        keep=["pilot"],
        show_fe=True,
        felabels={"gvkey": "Firm FE", "year": "Year FE"},
        custom_model_stats={"Controls": ["No", "Yes", "No", "Yes"]},
    ))

def fit_by_year(df: pl.DataFrame, dv: str = "da_adj",
                controls: bool = True):
    data = df.with_columns(year=pl.col("datadate").dt.year())
    rhs = "C(year)*pilot - pilot - 1"
    if controls:
        rhs = rhs + " + " + " + ".join(ctrls_list)
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.filterwarnings(
            "ignore", category=UserWarning, module="pyfixest"
        )
        return pf.feols(
            f"{dv} ~ {rhs}",
            data=data,
            vcov={"CRV1": "year + gvkey"},
        )

def plot_coefficients(fit):
    return (
        pl.from_pandas(fit.coef().reset_index())
        .with_columns(
            year=pl.col("Coefficient")
                .str.extract(r"C\(year\)\[(?:T\.)?(\d+)\]", 1)
                .cast(pl.Int32),
            pilot=pl.col("Coefficient").str.contains(r":pilot")
        )
        .filter(pl.col("year").is_not_null())
        .select("year", "pilot", "Estimate")
        .sort("pilot", "year")
        .ggplot()
        .aes(x="year", y="Estimate", color="pilot", linetype="pilot")
        .geom_line()
        .geom_rect(
            aes(xmin=2005, xmax=2007, ymin=-np.inf, ymax=np.inf),
            inherit_aes=False,
            fill="black",
            alpha=0.01,
        )
        .scale_x_continuous(breaks=list(range(2000, 2013)))
        .labs(x="Year", y="Coefficient")
        .theme_bw()
    )

def get_coef_rand(i: int, base_df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    treat = (
        base_df
        .select("gvkey", "pilot")
        .unique()
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("pilot").shuffle(seed=2021 + i).alias("pilot")
        )
    )
    reg_data_alt = (
        base_df
        .drop("pilot")
        .join(treat, on="gvkey", how="inner")
    )
    fit = reg_year_fe(
        reg_data_alt, controls=True, firm_fe=True, cl_2=False
    )
    return (
        pl.from_pandas(fit.tidy().reset_index())
        .select("Coefficient", "Estimate")
        .with_columns(iteration=pl.lit(i))
        .pivot(index="iteration", on="Coefficient", values="Estimate")
    )
```

```{python}
        [get_coef_rand(i, sho_accruals) for i in range(n_sims)],
        how="vertical",
    )
```
